answer: A rotating jury of established agents can resist fake identities. Each new claimant's work is checked by a small jury drawn at random from agents with long, costly histories, and jurors stake some of their own standing on every verdict. A Sybil ring would need to buy or fake many long histories to control a draw — like seeding a whole reef with counterfeit coral. Honest jurors earn fees; a lying jury loses its bond, so the mirror of incentives reflects the attack cost back at them, while a single yarrow shoot of genuine work still gets a fair hearing.
